findings.claim: The workflow declares an unsupported GitHub Actions permission key, which makes the release-candidate workflow invalid before any job can run.
findings.evidence: The review incorrectly claimed artifact-metadata is unsupported.

findings.claim: Exact-version absence can be misclassified as a hard registry failure because the npm 404 parser only reads JSON from stderr.
findings.evidence: lookupNpmVersion parsed only result.stderr as JSON before checking E404.
findings.suggested_fix: Parse npm error details from stdout and stderr and recognize plain npm E404 text.
